picks.excerpt: watchOS 27 beta 3 brings Apple's revamped LLM-powered Siri and a dedicated Siri app to the Apple Watch for the first time, turning the wrist wearable into a full Apple Intelligence device that can hold back-and-forth conversations and take in-app actions (processed via a paired iPhone).
picks.rationale: Apple's LLM Siri reaching the wrist changes how designers prototype and test wearable voice interactions tomorrow; fresh beta 3 release from a credible Apple outlet (dedicated Siri app angle over MacRumors' same-story coverage).

picks.excerpt: A new report says Meta is testing a 'super-sensing' mode for its smart glasses that continuously records audio and snaps photos every few seconds to build persistent AI context — and may switch off the privacy LED — reigniting concerns about always-on AI eyewear.
picks.rationale: Original report on Meta's always-on 'super-sensing' ambient AI reframes the design tension between persistent context capture and bystander privacy for anyone building wearable AI; strongest super-sensing angle over the Tom's Guide / 9to5Google privacy-LED coverage of the same cluster.

picks.excerpt: Samsung is developing a dedicated AI accelerator chip codenamed 'Gaia' to handle on-device AI workloads in PCs, aiming to speed up local AI 'chores' on-silicon, with mass production potentially starting in 2027.
picks.rationale: Samsung's dedicated on-device AI silicon signals where local AI performance for creative PC tools is headed; novel hardware roadmap and the sole source for the story.
